name: Primeval History
summary: Creation, the Fall, the Flood and the Tower of Babel (Genesis 1–11). The story of humanity before God's call of Abram.
dateNote: Placed using the genealogies of Genesis 5 and 11 (Masoretic text). Many readers and scholars do not take these as an exact chronology, so no firm dates are shown.

name: The Patriarchs
summary: Abraham, Isaac, Jacob and Joseph: God's covenant family, from Abram's call to Jacob's move to Egypt (Genesis 12–50).
dateNote: Counted back from an Exodus in 1446 BC, 430 years in Egypt (Exodus 12:40) and the ages given in Genesis.

name: Egypt & Exodus
summary: Israel grows into a nation in Egypt, is enslaved, and is brought out by God through Moses (Exodus 1–15).

name: Wilderness
summary: The covenant at Sinai, the tabernacle, and forty years in the wilderness before entering Canaan (Exodus 16 – Deuteronomy).
